session.description: First-party Web App session (Wave 3A). Mutating requests also need the X-CSRF-Token header and the exact Origin; a request with both a session cookie and a bearer token is refused.
session.name: __Host-exdb_session

info.description: Read endpoints of /api/v1 defined in Wave 1, the access, plan and approval endpoints of Wave 3A, the delegation endpoints of Wave 3B and the registry, schema, health and finding endpoints of Wave 4. x-exponetdb-wave names the wave that serves an operation; an operation of a later wave is contract only until then. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457) with the ExponetDB error catalog. Observed state carries source and observedAt; a failed live read is an error, never an empty list. A request carries exactly one credential: a Web App session (the __Host-exdb_session cookie; mutating requests also need X-CSRF-Token and the exact Origin), an OAuth access token for the audience https://db.exponet.cloud/api, or an API key of a service account. 401 and 403 answers carry a WWW-Authenticate Bearer challenge with resource_metadata (RFC 9728).
